entries.title: Isaiah 34:1
segments: ¶Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it. {all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof}

words.text: , and all things that come forth
of it. {all that...: Heb. the fulness thereof}

entries.title: Isaiah 34:2
segments: For the indignation of the LORD [is] upon all nations, and [his] fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:3
segments: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:4
segments: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling [fig] from the fig tree.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:5
segments: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:6
segments: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, [and] with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:7
segments: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness. {unicorns: or, rhinocerots} {soaked: or, drunken}

entries.title: Isaiah 34:8
segments: For [it is] the day of the LORD'S vengeance, [and] the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:9
segments: ¶And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:10
segments: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:11
segments: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness. {cormorant: or, pelican}

words.text: in it: and he shall stretch out

entries.title: Isaiah 34:12
segments: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none [shall be] there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

words.text: , but none [shall be] there, and all her princes

entries.title: Isaiah 34:13
segments: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, [and] a court for owls. {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

words.text: thereof: and it shall be an habitation
. {owls: or, ostriches: Heb. daughters of the owl}

entries.title: Isaiah 34:14
segments: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest. {The wild...desert: Heb. Ziim} {the wild...island: Heb. Ijim} {screech...: or, night monster}

words.text: The wild beasts of the desert
with the wild beasts of the island
for herself a place of rest
. {The wild...desert: Heb. Ziim} {the wild...island: Heb. Ijim} {screech...: or, night monster}

entries.title: Isaiah 34:15
segments: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:16
segments: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

entries.title: Isaiah 34:17
segments: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
